_comment: District 7 (GDD §4.1 chain order). Prereq verified in data/districts/district_police.tres: powered_by = [&"park"] (NOT gas_station, NOT the linear chain order). police is NOT a leaf — industrial.powered_by = [warehouses, police]. Threat roster (scripts/enemies/enemy_pool.gd): watcher, hunter, destroyer — destroyer LEADS the late-roster lesson: it does not react to light (GDD §6.2), so the school's flashlight-stun and the park's noise rule are not enough here. Themed loot canon (district_loot.gd BY_DISTRICT): key, medkit, tool, gunpowder, case. Blueprint CANON: BLUEPRINTS[police] = blueprint_backpack_capacity (the D7 backpack capacity schematic). Story doc canon: doc_evacuation_order (second list, 47 people, school yard 04:00). Puzzle canon: puzzle_system.gd transformer_police (reward 2 battery, power_stage 2). GDD §9 places the strobe workbench at D7 interrogation — there is no strobe blueprint id in data/items, so the room is flavour (police_note_08) not a new item. Repair-part guarantee mirrors district_loot.gd REPAIR_PARTS (2x cable/fuse/transistor). All item ids verified against data/items/*.tres (41 ids, 2026-09).

fixed_spawns.reason: Guarantee: cable for PARTIAL. Grid-crew leftovers at the transformer cage (police_note_03); unlocked.

Guarantee: fuse for STREETS. Spare fuses in the dispatch rack by the handset — police_note_03 states it in-world. This district's puzzle is transformer_police, but power_switch still needs the fuse step.
Guarantee: transistor for FULL, in the locked evidence room; opened by police_fix_key_01 — no lockpick required (R1).
Evidence-room key in the sergeant's unlocked blotter drawer. Reachable in DARK with zero tools.
BLUEPRINTS canon: the D7 backpack-capacity schematic. Seized with a scavenger pack in interrogation 2; guaranteed, not rolled (R7).
Themed guarantee (BY_DISTRICT): armory cage always pays out powder — ingredients, never a firearm (R4). Non-RNG by R6.
Themed guarantee (BY_DISTRICT): empty casings in the same cage. The armory must feel stripped, not stocked.
Duty first-aid still in cell 1's bunk box; the cells are the destroyer's wing, so the heal sits where the lesson is.
Ready-made defense cache in the front-lot bin; STREETS only (R2). Kept off the generator pad (R8).
Battery top-up on arrival from the park road; the front lot is the safe pocket.

rules: R1: In DARK, fixed_spawns alone must cover the repair chain (>=2 cable, >=2 fuse, >=2 transistor); the evidence-room key (police_fix_key_01) sits in an unlocked desk drawer, so the transistors are reachable with zero lockpicks and zero rolled loot.

R2: Rolled loot never includes stage-gated items early: table lookup uses the CURRENT DistrictData.Stage only. Finished molotovs and noise_bombs enter rolls at PARTIAL/STREETS; in DARK the player gets materials (case, tool, gunpowder from the armory fixed spawn), never the weapon. gunpowder itself is a material and may appear in DARK only via the armory fixed spawn, not the DARK roll table.
R3: Fixed spawns are one-time per save; rolls are per-container with container_modifiers on qty.

R4: No firearms in police. There is no pistol/rifle/ammo id in data/items. gunpowder + case are crafting feedstock (empty casings, powder from old rounds). molotov/noise_bomb/firework remain the combat ceiling.

R5: Destroyer-led: the destroyer does not react to light (GDD §6.2). The rich containers (evidence_locker 1.5, armory_cage 1.4) sit in dead-end rooms with one door (evidence, armory, cells). The front lot and courtyard are open and poor. A player who never enters a dead-end still finishes the district via R1. Do not teach 'cone = weapon' here — police_note_02 and R5 are the same sentence.
R6: Armory and evidence caches must not roll empty — both are scripted caches, not RNG (mirrors park's keeper shed, school's shelter, hospital's pharmacy, gas_station's tanker).

R7: Blueprint guarantee: police_fix_blueprint_01 (blueprint_backpack_capacity) is the district's one schematic per district_loot.gd BLUEPRINTS. It is a fixed spawn, never a roll, reachable in DARK (interrogation 2 is unlocked). No other blueprint id may spawn here.
R8: Powder discipline: no fixed spawn places gunpowder inside z_generator_room or z_radio_room (transformer_police pad / live dispatch rack). Powder lives in the armory cage only.
